title: Queue-depth block text sizes are raw 14, not hud-scaled — breaks the panel's 7.3 UI-scale doctrine and mismatches its own geometry test's model
evidence: app/qos_panel.odin:431 `draw_text(app, depth_label, rnd.hud(&app.view, QOS_PANEL_X + 10), qos_qd_line_y(&app.view, qd_y, 0) + rnd.hud(&app.view, 3), 14, p.ink_soft_text)`; :439 `draw_text(app, dirs[dir], rnd.hud(&app.view, QOS_PANEL_X + QOS_QD_INDENT), dy + rnd.hud(&app.view, 3), 14, p.ink_soft_text)`; :448 `draw_text(app, depth_str, qdx, dy + rnd.hud(&app.view, 3), 14, col)` — vs the panel's own convention at :416 `draw_text(app, wv, qos_value_between(&app.view, m, ppp), y + rnd.hud(&app.view, 4), rnd.hud(&app.view, 14), p.ink)` and the new test's model at app/qos_panel_test.odin:67-68 `testing.expect(t, qos_qd_line_y(&v, qd_y, line) + rnd.hud(&v, 14) <= qos_qd_line_y(&v, qd_y, line + 1), "queue-depth lines must not overlap")`
detail: The 7.3 ruling scales ALL panel text through rnd.hud ("the row math is the single source every rect + the draw share", in this diff's own qos_panel_h comment). The rewritten block scales positions but not text sizes — at ×1.50 the depth readout renders 14px amid 21px panel text.
recommended_fix: Pass rnd.hud(&app.view, 14) as the size argument at the three queue-depth draw_text sites (depth label line 431, dir labels line 439, lane cells line 448).
